tex_content.html:
Definition
[vertical and horizontal distributions, basic horizontal lift]

Source: petersen:page-0162, petersen:page-0163 For a Riemannian submersion $F:(\bar M,\bar g)\to (M,g)$, the vertical distribution is $\mathcal V_{\bar p}=\ker DF_{\bar p}\subset T_{\bar p}\bar M$ and the horizontal distribution is $\mathcal H_{\bar p}=(\mathcal V_{\bar p})^\perp $; $DF:\mathcal H_{\bar p}\to T_pM$ is an isometry. For a vector field $X$ on $M$, its unique horizontal, $F$-related lift is the basic horizontal lift $\bar X$. Every $v\in T_{\bar p}\bar M$ decomposes as $v=v^{\mathcal H}+v^{\mathcal V}$.
